name: table
title: Table
description: Semantic styled table with caption, density, sticky header, sortable header affordance and a stacked-card mode on small screens.

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableSectionProps } from './index'
import { inject } from 'vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { tableContextKey } from './index'

const props = defineProps<TableSectionProps>()
const context = inject(tableContextKey, { stack: false })

    <slot />

</template>
